title: complete waits its turn for a trial container instead of failing after 600 s
description: Runs the real CLI complete, control plane, host verification pump and trial admission launcher with stand-in docker and df while another start holds every trial container slot on the machine. complete shows why it waits and keeps waiting past any give-up instead of failing as a trial-host fault; once the slot frees, the verification starts and finishes, the submission is recorded with the head as candidate, and the item records no blocker.

steps.name: complete waits for a trial slot, then verifies and submits
